name: Eleanor Harrow
bio:
Eleanor founded the firm in 1998 with a simple idea: clients should be able to reach the lawyer who is handling their matter.

She advises owner-managed businesses on formation, financing and succession, and she helps families plan for the transfer of a business or a home to the next generation. Clients value her patience with detail and her habit of explaining a document line by line.

Eleanor chairs the Harlow Small Business Council and teaches an evening course on contracts at a local community college.

name: Daniel Vance
bio:
Daniel leads the firm's litigation practice. He has tried cases in the state courts of Ohio and in federal court, and he is known for telling clients early and plainly what a case is likely to cost.

He represents businesses and individuals in contract, partnership and employment disputes, and he serves as a mediator in commercial matters.

Outside the office Daniel coaches a youth debate league and volunteers with the county legal aid clinic.

name: Naomi Okafor
bio:
Naomi advises employers and employees on the full range of workplace questions, from handbooks and agreements to terminations and disputes.

She also handles contested family matters, where her calm manner and careful preparation help clients through difficult months.

Naomi is a member of the Harlow County Bar Association's grievance committee.

name: Marcus Avery
bio:
Marcus handles residential and commercial property transactions and the leases, loans and entity work that go with them.

He is a frequent speaker at landlord association meetings and likes to say that the best lease is the one nobody has to read twice because it was written clearly.

Before joining the firm he worked in the legal department of a regional lender.

name: Elena Moreno
bio:
Elena focuses on family law and estate planning. She works with clients on parenting arrangements, support and property questions, and she helps families put wills, trusts and powers of attorney in place.

She speaks English and Spanish and welcomes clients in either language.

Elena volunteers as a guardian ad litem trainee with the county court.
